noah: Quick thread to decide pilot shape for a hybrid pricing model: 'CapacitySeat + Consumption Credits'. Customers ask for predictable baseline performance with optional burst credits. Need a simple pilot offer and non-negotiables.

tara: TL;DR: propose two SKU axes: 1) CapacitySeat = reserved baseline throughput (per-month), 2) CreditPack = monthly burst credits measured in compute-units (CU). Combineable. Pilot should keep SLAs unchanged.

eli: Tech notes: we can map CU -> token-equivalent per model, but better to meter CU = vCPU-seconds-equivalent for fairness across models. Sample knobs for pilot:
```
capacity_seat.qps = 2000
capacity_seat.multiplier = 2.0  # baseline throughput factor
credit_pack.monthly_cu = 120000
burst_window_sec = 600
per_tenant_hard_qps = 5000
```
Need cluster-level fairness if many tenants consume CU simultaneously. Telemetry: hp.capacity_qps, hp.cu_used, hp.cluster_cu_remaining.

priya-sales: Sales-friendly pricing examples for pilot (simple table):
- Seat-Standard: $1,500/mo (2x baseline) + optional CreditPack-Small: $800/mo (100k CU)
- Seat-Premium: $4,500/mo (3x baseline) + CreditPack-Large: $2,200/mo (300k CU)
Overage: $0.06 per 1k CU-equivalent. Pilot incentive: 25% off month 1 or 50k trial CU. Negotiable levers: included CU, commit term, accelerated support. Non-negotiable: "unlimited" burst or guaranteed cross-cluster isolation.

noah: Contract side: we must define CU precisely and include a short customer-facing line: "CreditPacks provide prioritized capacity subject to platform health; they do not constitute an absolute capacity guarantee and may be throttled to preserve stability." Legal to draft formal wording.

contracts-bot: Noted. Also flag requests for dedicated SLA (higher uptime/latency promise)  require legal approval and commit anchoring. I'll draft the standard clause and a short checklist for exceptions.

billing-bot: Billing requirements: new SKUs `hybrid.seat.standard`, `hybrid.seat.premium`, `hybrid.credit.small`, `hybrid.credit.large`. Meter names: hybrid.cu_used, hybrid.seat_reserved_qps. Need invoice metadata `pilot=true` and `commit_id` when discount applied. Support CU refunding rules (no rollover by default).

sre-bot: Operational runbook: if cluster CU pool < 15% then signal SRE and execute cross-tenant fairness policy: reduce per-tenant soft_qps by 20% and route overflow to standard lane. Admin override allowed with audit log. Keep 30d telemetry retention for pilot.

eli: Edge case: mixed-model tenants will prefer token -> CU conversion. We'll ship a conversion table in billing spec and a transparency doc showing example math for gpt-like vs decoder-only models.

priya-sales: Pilot acceptance criteria: 1) 2 paid pilots onboarded, 2) console shows seat + credit balance, 3) billing meters & sample invoice, 4) telemetry + alerts + 30d logs, 5) legal-approved CU definition and clause, 6) runbook for cluster exhaustion. Target pilot launch ~4 weeks.

noah: Action items: eli -> CU conversion table + telemetry events, tara -> PRD + pricing one-pager, priya -> lock pilot customers and playbook, contracts-bot -> draft clause. If no objections we lock numbers tomorrow and start legal/billing work.

priya-sales: Pinged three prospects (BrightLayer, OrbitApps, NovaPay) with the pilot offer. Will report back by EOD. :white_check_mark:

eli: Feature-flag `hybrid_capacity` toggled on in staging. Running integration tests.

sre-bot: NOTE: feature-flag "hybrid_capacity" enabled in staging; alerting rule tests queued.

noah: Thanks all. Keep replies short  I'll collate final PRD and hand to legal tomorrow.
